## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: ...`, `fix(scope): ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behavior
- [ ] Database migrations are backward compatible (old code still runs on the new schema)
- [ ] Unfinished work is behind a feature flag
- [ ] No secrets, connection strings, or personal data in code, config, or logs
- [ ] README / docs updated if setup or behavior changed
